messages:
claire (PM): Quick sync  proposing "Policy Runway" for regional SLAs and tenant isolation. Need prioritization and launch gates.

sumit (Arch): +1. Separate policy primitives (affinity/fallback/quarantine) from enforcement. Ship DSL first.

diego (Eng): Two tracks: decision engine + slice infra. Prototype single-region DSL in ~8w if scoped.

anya (SRE): Ops asks: per-route telemetry, rollback to global default, chaos tests.

michael (Sales): Customers want geo pinning + residency + 99.9 SLA language. Quick win = pinning docs.

claire (PM): Draft gates: DSL v1 + docs, runtime routing + fallback <10ms p95, 2 weeks telemetry proving SLA, failover runbook.

sumit (Arch): Add migration plan and backward compatibility. Surface egress/billing/legal risks.

diego (Eng): Cache strategy matters: local KV cache for hot keys; cold-path spikes. Example DSL snippet: 
```
route { match: tenant=="T-123" && region=="eu-west-1" action: route_to(slice:europe-primary) fallback:eu-fallback ttl:30s }
```

anya (SRE): Propose policy propagation SLO: <60s for 95%. I'll draft runbook.

michael (Sales): I'll gather top-3 customer asks and FAQ language for failover.

claire (PM): Actions: Sumit write DSL spec (this week), Diego estimate effort by Fri, Anya open runbook PR, Michael collect customer asks. I'll assemble roadmap for exec.

deploy-bot: triggered deployment infra/prototyping/policy-dsl -> staging at 1923464000.

claire (PM): Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
